Lewis and Stielstra are excellent, harnessing both Will and Mike’s New Relationship Energy and burgeoning self-awareness.

cn.t: Critics warmly embrace this intimate two-person musical, praising its heartfelt portrayal of young love and Matthew Sweet's evocative 90s soundtrack. Reviewers celebrate the show's touching, joyful exploration of first romance that resonates universally.
